authority.user_statement: Ok chat move forward. Please make sure you do this every time you propose a new direction for our work (experiment, pivot, etc.)
authority.scope: Implement and run the proposed fixed single CPU global-CLS versus point-token comparison after explicit session-history/research reconciliation. No fitting, GPU execution, labels, selector or protected evaluation.
authority.standing_rule: Before every new direction, reconcile accumulated sessions and relevant research with primary evidence, explain coverage/limits and remaining alternatives.

execution.input_order: historical unique inputs first, then remaining stable prepared registry order
execution.resume: explicit; validate immutable successes; retain every failed attempt and forward start/return journal
execution.time_estimate_limit: Historical extrapolation, not a wall-clock cap or guaranteed duration.

CLS_parity.mismatch_policy: Preserve attempt and diagnose preprocessing/environment drift; never redefine control or use mismatched output as a scientific result.

readouts.global: Final normalized sequence token0, equal to pooler_output.
readouts.point: Float64 weighted sum of four raw final-LayerNorm patch-token vectors using each exact prepared query weight; then one L2 normalization. Never normalize each patch before interpolation.
readouts.normalization: Float64 L2 for each query/bank vector separately.

geometry.padding_policy: record exact pixels; no absence inference

readouts.invalid_vector: Explicit unavailable descriptor/margin with reason; unknown is neither correct retention nor successful rejection.
readouts.padding: Retain finite scores with explicit complete-source/padded strata. Padding never implies absence or semantic class. No outcome-selected exclusion.

reference_bank.rule: Maximum cosine to the4ball bank references minus maximum cosine to the6other-object bank references.
reference_bank.matching: CLS query to CLS bank; point query to point bank; same10 accepted SAC identities.
reference_bank.unknown_bank: Never drop an unknown bank member. Mark that representation margin unavailable with a reason.

analysis.HOU: All6 complete contexts; per-episode and explicitly descriptive pooled results. Repeatedly inspected development, no fitting.
analysis.ranks: Within-frame best <=10px eligible match against all geometric localization misses; strict/tie counts; complete-feature paired comparisons only.
analysis.paired: Point versus CLS on same candidates; compare fixed peak and native-only mass as separate existing comparators.
bounds: score>=minimum margin of842 original native-correct points
analysis.bound_scope: One shared HOU diagnostic cutoff per representation; unchanged per-episode reporting; no production threshold.
analysis.stress: All960 old expanded-weak rows; separately preserve21 correct gains from native missing, ten e01 gains, six sub-.01e05 gains, original hidden and all unknown cases.
analysis.correction_subsets: Report six gains over native and27 native-correct losses of prior corrected strong arm if joined exactly from original records; diagnostic subsets only.
analysis.padding: Count and report complete-source/padded strata at the same shared thresholds and paired rankings; no separately chosen thresholds.
analysis.historical: Keep10 bank,10 accepted checks,6unresolved and34exposed cases separate. Accepted DET diagnostic-only; no parameter/model choice from DET. Preserve nearest-bank versus fitted-logistic failure provenance.
analysis.limits: This is representation feasibility, not achieved tracking accuracy or proof that every alternative fails.

decision.continue: Meaningful recurring paired ordering and hidden-separation gains while protecting native-correct and useful weak points can justify a separately specified selection/abstention test; final acceptance need not already pass.
decision.mixed_or_negative: Preserve all gains/losses and diagnose representation, bank coverage, calibration and candidate-offset limitations. Reject only the tested setting, not all appearance or temporal methods.
